title: Federal Law No. 296-FZ on Limiting Greenhouse Gas Emissions
citation: Federal Law of 2021-07-02 No. 296-FZ 'Об ограничении выбросов парниковых газов'
evidence: Art. 14(1) of the act as published (page 20 of the PDF, eoNumber 0001202107020031, published 2021-07-02): "Настоящий Федеральный закон вступает в силу по истечении ста восьмидесяти дней после дня его официального опубликования." The page gives a rule, not a date.
notes: Climate framework act, mapped to F2; its mandatory GHG reporting for regulated organisations (Art. 7, Art. 14(2) and (3): 150,000 t CO2e a year or more from 2023-01-01, 50,000 t or more from 2025-01-01) is F3 content, carried by ru-gov-decree-707-2022, ru-gov-decree-355-2022 and ru-gov-decree-1580-2025. in_force is null because no opened page states a date: counting 180 days from 2021-07-02 gives 2021-12-29, which is a calculation, not a reading. The existing register row pointed at a Prosecutor General explainer page (epp.genproc.gov.ru, not the official publisher, HTTP 400 to curl); its official_source_url is replaced by the portal page, title kept. Only pages 19 and 20 were read. No amending act titled with this law's name was found in the portal search of 2026-11-03. Link only: the official PDF is a scanned image with no text layer (pdftotext prints nothing, no OCR in the repo), so no text is stored although the row passes. Civil Code Art. 1259(6)(1) (official documents of state bodies, including laws, are not objects of copyright) is the statute basis for the text on this state host. Russian is the state language and the only language the publication portal serves; no English page was opened there, so no translation record.
status_note: Official PDF is a scan with no text layer; no OCR in the repo.

title: Government Decree No. 707 of 2022-04-20 on the rules for submitting and verifying greenhouse gas emission reports, the report form and the greenhouse gas emissions register
citation: Постановление Правительства Российской Федерации от 20.04.2022 № 707, published 2022-04-21
evidence: Point 4 of the decree as published (page 2 of the PDF, eoNumber 0001202204210009): "Настоящее постановление вступает в силу со дня его официального опубликования, за исключением Правил представления и проверки отчетов о выбросах парниковых газов, утвержденных настоящим постановлением, и формы отчета о выбросах парниковых газов, утвержденной настоящим постановлением, которые вступают в силу с 1 сентября 2022 г. и действуют 6 лет."
notes: Implements Art. 5(1) items 1 and 2, Art. 7(2) and Art. 8 of 296-FZ (the preamble of the decree). in_force is the date of the reporting rules and the report form (2022-09-01, valid six years); the decree itself and its amendments to other Government acts took effect on publication, 2022-04-21. Only pages 1 and 2 were read. The brief called it the procedure for 'regulated organisations'; the title is the rules for reports on GHG emissions. title: Government Decree No. 355 of 2022-03-14 on the criteria for classifying legal entities and individual entrepreneurs as regulated organisations
citation: Постановление Правительства Российской Федерации от 14.03.2022 № 355, published 2022-03-15
evidence: Point 3 of the decree as published (page 1 of the PDF, eoNumber 0001202203150019): "Настоящее постановление вступает в силу с 1 сентября 2022 г. и действует до 1 января 2025 г."
notes: Issued under Art. 7(1) of 296-FZ. By its own point 3 the decree stopped applying on 2025-01-01; the later Decree No. 1580 of 2025-10-14 (ru-gov-decree-1580-2025) approves new criteria under the same article. No opened page says how the criteria were set between 2025-01-01 and 2025-10-15 or that 1580 repeals 355, so no repeal is recorded. Point 2 asks the Ministry of Economic Development for proposals by 2024-03-01 on the 50,000 t CO2e criterion. Only page 1 was read. The dispatch brief placed this number under 'criteria for regulated organisations', which the title confirms. title: Bank of Russia Information Letter No. IN-06-28/49 of 2021-07-12 on recommendations for disclosure of non-financial information by public joint-stock companies
citation: Информационное письмо Банка России от 12.07.2021 № ИН-06-28/49
evidence: Letter header: "от 12.07.2021 № ИН-06-28/49"; text: "Банк России направляет для применения рекомендации по раскрытию публичными акционерными обществами нефинансовой информации". No commencement clause, so the issue date is used (lookup policy). Opened https://www.cbr.ru/StaticHtml/File/117620/20210712_in-06-28_49.pdf on 2026-11-03 (200, application/pdf, 390999 bytes).
notes: Voluntary recommendations to public joint-stock companies, not a binding rule; the annex discusses climate change and ESG factors. Listed on https://www.cbr.ru/issuers_corporate/development_corp_relations/recom/ among the Bank of Russia recommendations. Whether a listing rule makes it binding was not checked (Moscow Exchange was not read beyond a 200 on the home page). Link only: the row RU-CBR-ADOPTED is permission requested (cbr.ru says the information 'cannot be considered an object for commercial use'), so nothing is stored. Civil Code Art. 1259(6)(1) was not applied because it names state bodies and whether a Bank of Russia letter is one was not settled. No English version found: the cbr.ru English site search for the title returned no result on 2026-11-03.
